record.paper_title: Erdős-Macintyre type theorem’s for multiple Dirichlet series: exceptional sets and open problems
record.original_question: Let f(z)=∑_{n=0}∞ a_n z^n be a nonconstant entire function, let M_f(r)=max{|f(z)|: |z|=r}, and let μ_f(r)=max_{n≥0}|a_n|r^n. For a fixed ε>0, Wiman's inequality is M_f(r)≤μ_f(r)(ln μ_f(r))^(1/2+ε) for all r outside an exceptional set E⊂[1,∞). Given an arbitrary set E=∪_{n=1}∞[a_n,b_n] of finite logarithmic measure ∫_E d ln r<∞, can one find an entire function f for which E can serve as the exceptional set in Wiman's inequality for that ε?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let f(z)=∑_{n=0}^∞ a_n z^n be a nonconstant entire function on ℂ. Define the maximum modulus M_f(r)=max{|f(z)|:|z|=r} and the maximal term μ_f(r)=max_{n≥0}|a_n|r^n. Fix ε>0. By Wiman's inequality, there exists a set E⊂[1,∞) such that
   M_f(r) ≤ μ_f(r)·(ln μ_f(r))^{1/2+ε}    for all r∈[1,∞)∖E,
and the exceptional set E may be chosen of finite logarithmic measure, i.e., ∫_E d(ln r) < ∞.

Question: Given ε>0 and an arbitrary set E = ⋃_{n=1}^∞ [a_n,b_n] ⊂ [1,∞) of finite logarithmic measure (∫_E d ln r < ∞), does there exist a nonconstant entire function f such that E is precisely an exceptional set for f in Wiman's inequality with this ε? That is, can every such set E be realized as the Wiman exceptional set of some entire function?
artifact.status_search_result: Surveys on Ostrovskii's work and recent papers on Wiman-type inequalities (2021–2024) refer to the Wiman problems posed by Levin and Ostrovskii in 1995 about the description of exceptional sets as still open. Partial sharpness results on the size of exceptional sets exist, but the realizability question (every set of finite logarithmic measure as an exceptional set) does not appear resolved.

status_evidence.title: Iossif Ostrovskii's work on entire functions
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of Ostrovskii's contributions including problems posed in 1995 on exceptional sets in Wiman inequality.
status_evidence.claim: References Ostrovskii's 1995 problem on exceptional sets in the Wiman inequality.

status_evidence.title: Wiman-Type Inequality in Multiple-Circular Domains
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2022) work on Wiman-type exceptional sets, characterizing their magnitude but not establishing full realizability of arbitrary finite-log-measure sets.
status_evidence.claim: Recent literature still investigates the description of Wiman exceptional sets, indicating the realizability problem remains open.
